limitations: The containing menu continuation remains Ghidra-unreachable, so runtime execution of this producer path is not claimed.
The individual coordinate pairs are not assigned to named actors without runtime or higher-level scene evidence.
conclusion: The former opaque 250-byte bank is a statically consumed scene-resource actor-coordinate stream with a recovered 62-pair plus sentinel format. Its exact ownership and deassembly representation are now semantic, while live reachability remains unresolved.
